description: This file defines the class VtigerCRMObject which manages CRM entities such as retrieve, create, update, delete, and other related operations within the vTiger CRM environment.

classes.name: VtigerCRMObject
classes.description: A class providing CRUD and utility operations for CRM objects based on module name or ID, interacting with the database and CRM instances.

methods.name: VtigerCRMObject
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with module credential, either ID or name, and retrieves the corresponding instance.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the CRM module class instance, creates it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getObjectId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the object instance.

methods.name: setObjectId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the object instance.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Fetches and populates the entity data from the database based on the given ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity record with provided data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the current entity with provided data.

methods.name: revise
methods.description: Reads the entity, updates fields, and saves changes, handling UTF-8 characters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the entity with specified ID.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the column fields of the current entity instance.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether an entity with given ID exists.

methods.name: getSEType
methods.description: Retrieves the setype of the entity with the specified ID.
